evidence: Official domain champittet.ch issues a 308 redirect to nordangliaeducation.com/champittet (Nord Anglia Education network), confirming the official site. Official curriculum: Swiss Maturité (bilingual FR-EN), French Baccalauréat, IB Diploma in English, plus French-as-Foreign-Language full-year immersion — so catalog's IB Diploma, Swiss Matura, and French Immersion programmes are all real (accurate). Main campus Pully/Lausanne on Lake Geneva (catalog correct; secondary Nyon campus for preschool/primary is omitted but nothing stated is wrong). PRICES: official 2026-27 day fees are in CHF (Grade 6 27,360; Grade 11 32,240; Grade 14 38,260) and full 7-day boarding is 112,000 CHF; catalog records tuition in EUR with boarding at 58,000 — wrong currency and boarding ~half of actual, so prices=wrong. Scholarships in catalog (Champittet Merit Award up to CHF 8,000/yr; Nord Anglia Foundation Scholarship) are not found on official admissions/fees pages, which only cite the Champittet Foundation funding scholarships for orphan girls in Madagascar — unverifiable/likely fabricated. Accommodation: on-campus Pully boarding is accurate; off-campus Lausanne option is generic and uncorroborated (stale). Sources: https://www.nordangliaeducation.com/champittet , https://www.nordangliaeducation.com/champittet/admissions/tuition-fees , https://www.nordangliaeducation.com/fr/champittet
